note: Frozen record of the dataset split used by scripts/train_transfer_cnn.py (EfficientNet-B0 / MobileNetV3-Small experiments, 2026-09-17). This is the SAME split already used for the balanced ResNet18 CNN (docs/curated_eczema_vs_disease_2026-08-26.md) -- reused, not regenerated, because it was already built the same way this protocol would have required (deterministic seed, stratified by class, image-level because no patient IDs exist for this dataset). See docs/transfer_cnn_experiment_2026-09-17.md for full reasoning.
split_method: 70/15/15, stratified by 8-way disease_class (not just binary label), image-level (no patient/subject IDs available for this dataset)
patient_level_splitting: NOT POSSIBLE -- this dataset merges 3 Kaggle/DermNet-style dermatology image archives (original Eczema/Normal set, SkinDisease 20-class set, and a third DermNet-subtype Eczema set), none of which carry patient or subject identifiers, only per-image files. Patient-level splitting is used elsewhere in this project (SkinDisNet, which does have 416 real patient IDs) but is structurally unavailable here.

test.status: HELD OUT -- not opened, read, or referenced by scripts/train_transfer_cnn.py or any code path used in this experiment. Not to be touched until explicit permission is given.

class_balance_conclusion: Train and val are both already ~50/50 Eczema vs Other (1165/1162 and 249/247) -- no class weighting or resampling applied in scripts/train_transfer_cnn.py.
